title: Product Sans / Cover
slide_intent: Introduce a typeface through its own letterforms so a reader encounters its character before technical explanations.
strategic_value: A large white specimen on Google blue can connect the typeface with the brand while keeping the name immediately readable.
demonstration: The clean archival cover places Product Sans on two large lines above a small white Google mark, with edition and folio labels along the top.
practical_value: Use the opening page to judge the typeface’s broad proportions and rhythm before inspecting individual glyphs.

content_islands.name: Running metadata
content_islands.spec: Align the typeface name, copyright, specimen label and P–1 along the top.

content_islands.name: Typeface title
content_islands.spec: Place the large two-line white title in the left half of the blue field.

content_islands.name: Brand signature
content_islands.spec: Place a small white Google wordmark at lower left.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cover demonstrates the typeface’s open, geometric forms in a large white-on-blue specimen.
